briefs.polymarket-3081965: The ECB raised its deposit facility rate by 25bp to 2.50% on Sept 10, 2026, its second hike, citing energy-driven inflation risk from the Iran war (CNBC, ECB press release). Lagarde said on Sept 28 that measured hikes remain appropriate, but in early October struck what Ebury called a surprisingly dovish tone, arguing the rise in long-term yields since September will slow growth and damp energy pass-through. Ebury (Oct 8) judged an October hike unlikely despite a September inflation beat, with December still possible. As of Sept 24, rates futures (ECB Watch) priced roughly 60% for a hike on Oct 29; Goldman and UBS expected December, Danske October, MUFG no more hikes. Nagel (Sept 22) said it was too early to call. The meeting is Oct 28-29. Sources: https://www.fxstreet.com/analysis/ecb-october-hike-looks-unlikely-lagarde-strikes-a-surprisingly-dovish-tone-202610080843, https://admiralmarkets.com/analytics/traders-blog/ecb-meeting-october-2026, https://money.usnews.com/investing/news/articles/2026-09-28/measured-ecb-hikes-to-quell-inflation-remain-appropriate-lagarde-says
briefs.polymarket-4824602: Serbia holds a snap parliamentary election for 250 seats on Oct 25, 2026, called by Vucic on Sept 8 (bne IntelliNews). The student protest movement runs a full 250-name list, 'Student List - Students Are Winning' (New Union Post, Sept 15; Balkan Insight, Sept 11). Polls diverge by pollster: CRTA with Stanford's Democracy Action Lab (face-to-face, June 10-24, n=2,324) found 44.9% backing the Student List against 35.7% of committed voters for SNS, with 12% undecided (Vreme, July 15). Faktor Plus (Sept 16-20) put the Vucic-led United Serbia list at 48.6% and the Student List at 37.1%, up 5.6 points (BTA, Sept 21). bne IntelliNews reported earlier in 2026 that the Student List overtook SNS in a poll. The ruling party controls most national broadcast media; the question resolves on which list wins the most seats. Sources: https://www.bta.bg/en/news/balkans/1208852-poll-vucic-led-list-at-48-6-student-list-at-37-1-ahead-of-serbia-s-parliamen, https://vreme.com/en/vesti/studentska-lista-sns-izbori-istrazivanje-javnog-mnjenja/, https://www.intellinews.com/student-list-overtakes-serbia-s-ruling-sns-in-poll-ahead-of-expected-elections-455084/

briefs.polymarket-3251572: Eurostat's third estimate (Sept 7, 2026) put euro area Q2 2026 GDP at +0.6% q/q and +1.2% y/y, revised up from 1.0% y/y; Q1 2026 was +0.6% y/y (Trading Economics; Eurostat release). The preliminary flash had been +0.4% q/q against +0.2% expected. Q3 2025 grew roughly 0.2-0.3% q/q, which drops out of the year-on-year comparison. The ECB raised rates in July and September 2026 amid an energy price shock from the Iran war and flagged weaker growth risk. Trading Economics' model forecasts Q3 2026 at 1.0% y/y. The Q3 flash estimate is due Oct 30 and is reported to one decimal; a value exactly on a bracket edge counts toward the higher bracket. Sources: https://tradingeconomics.com/euro-area/gdp-growth-annual, https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/products-euro-indicators/w/2-07092026-ap, https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/10/ecb-interest-rate-hike-lagarde-iran.html
briefs.polymarket-2110579: Israel's Knesset election is on Oct 27, 2026. The Petek's average of the last 10 polls (as of Oct 8) gives Likud 23 seats, up 1 since Sept 30, with individual polls ranging from 19 to 32; the Oct 8 polls had Likud at 20 (Zman Yisrael) and 26 (Direct Polls / i24NEWS). Eisenkot's Yashar and Likud trade first place, and the blocs are near a tie (Jerusalem Post, Times of Israel, Haaretz Sept 27). Likud runs as its own list; its allies Otzma Yehudit, Shas, UTJ and Religious Zionism run separately. In 2022 Likud won 32 seats after final polls of about 30-31. Sources: https://www.thepetek.com/polls, https://www.jpost.com/israel-election-2026/article-911139, https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/toi-poll-anti-netanyahu-bloc-regains-lead-eisenkots-yashar-comes-1st-with-likud-in-2nd-place/
briefs.manifold-OqEUCA9tCN: The FOMC raised the federal funds target range by 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on Sept 16, 2026, unanimously. Minutes released Oct 7 said most officials saw another increase as likely by year end, while Governor Jefferson and New York Fed President Williams signalled patience (The Hill). Recent US core PCE inflation came in softer than expected (FXStreet, Oct 8). As of Oct 8, CME FedWatch futures priced roughly 80% for no change at the Oct 27-28 meeting. December's meeting brings a new Summary of Economic Projections. The question resolves YES only on an increase in the target range at the Oct 27-28 meeting. Sources: https://thehill.com/business/6135206-fed-officials-project-future-increases/amp, https://kaohooninternational.com/economics/592288, https://www.fxstreet.com/analysis/ecb-october-hike-looks-unlikely-lagarde-strikes-a-surprisingly-dovish-tone-202610080843
briefs.manifold-Qgu99q9Lpu: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon on Sept 30, 2026, releasing it first to vetted cyber defenders in its Fairwind Program, internal teams and, under voluntary pre-release access, US government agencies (RuntimeWire, Oct 8). Google's Sept 30 post and Oct 2 recap say paid Gemini API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers come next 'as soon as possible', with developers, enterprises and consumers after guardrails are refined; no date was given. As of Oct 1 (Aireiter) and Oct 3 (AICoder) Argon was absent from the public model list, pricing page and changelog. A social-media claim (Oct 2) of a public release 'as soon as next week' and claims of an Oct 8-10 launch were unconfirmed as of Oct 8. The question needs unvetted public access via API, AI Studio, Vertex AI or a consumer subscription by Oct 14, 23:59 PT. Sources: https://runtimewire.com/article/everything-we-know-about-google-s-gemini-4-argon, https://aicoder.com/news/news-20261003-gemini-4-argon-next-week-unverified, https://aireiter.com/blog/gemini-4-argon-api-pricing-availability
